To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we propose a novel approach to the tasks of denoising and inpainting that combines sparse coding with deep neural networks pre trained with DA; 2) we propose an alternative training strategy for DA, that adapts it to the tasks of inpainting and denoising and that can improve unsupervised feature extraction.
sparse coding and deep neural networks can be combined to achieve state-of-art performance in image denoising, and that deep auto encoders can be trained to solve blind image inpainting problems.
We have proposed an alternative training scheme for denoising auto encoders that is more effective and applicable to the tasks of unsupervised image denoising, blind inpainting, and feature learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of learning a sparse representation of an image from its noisy or corrupted observations.
the application of deep neural networks to image denoising inpainting.
the problem of learning representations of natural images that can be used in low level vision tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed training scheme for DA, combined with sparse coding, can solve a variety of low level vision problems, and is a powerful and effective tool for feature learning.
our proposed method is able to perform image denoising with comparable accuracy to KSVD and can perform blind inpainting for complex patterns, which KSVD cannot.
the proposed method is a new and promising approach to low level computer vision problems that combines the strengths of sparse coding and deep neural networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a new training scheme for deep neural network, which is able to improve the performance of the network in both unsupervised feature extraction and image denoising.
we propose a new method for image denoising/inpainting and show its effectiveness.
we have proposed a novel approach for solving low-level vision problems, which is based on a combination of sparse coding and deep neural networks.

deep networks pre trained by our proposed training scheme can learn to solve complex vision problems like blind inpainting and can be used as a general purpose tool for low level image processing.
deep learning can be successfully combined with sparse representation techniques to solve low level vision problems.
deep neural networks can be used to solve low level vision tasks that have not been previously tackled with deep neural networks.
